correctness.rationale: For all r>=1 over C, the incidence B_s is a smooth bilinear complete intersection; the classical secant-bundle fiber is P^(s-l), giving the precise constructible-function subtraction. Proper CSM pushforward and adjunction yield the coefficient formula. Formal residue/Lagrange inversion solves a quadratic generating relation and identifies it with a constant term having the stated binomial coefficients. Aluffi triangular inversion proves polar-degree polynomiality. Integer checks for r=1..12 independently reproduce the pushforwards. Finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof. Limits: no claims for arbitrary curves, other characteristics or arbitrary secant ranks.

originality.rationale: Nogueira Conjecture 4.1 is a conditional all-rank assertion; his Theorem 4.11 predicts but does not prove the binomial class. This result supplies a complete all-rank pushforward and residue proof. Brogan determines secant-resolution fibers and intersection cohomology but does not present the claimed all-rank CSM equality. Mathematics-record and accessible-claim comparisons revealed no stronger result with the same implication. A genuinely independent/unindexed derivation remains possible.
residual_risks: The all-rank binomial formula may have been proved in an unindexed article, dissertation, or note not found by the searches.
A more general determinantal CSM theorem may imply the result without mentioning rational normal secants.
The 2016 workshop abstract by N. Medeiros discusses CSM computations as work in progress, but not a verified completed all-rank proof.

value.rationale: Proves both parts of a named published algebraic-geometry conjecture, with a uniform closed integral class formula for an infinite family of singular projective hypersurface complements. The apolar resolution cancellation and radical generating function explain the coefficients structurally and link characteristic classes with polar-map degrees.
